name: De-Sloppify Pass
description: Senior-style diff review, minimal fixes, project quality checks — not generic npm theater.
kickoff:
Start the "De-Sloppify Pass" loop.
Goal: diff is clean and convention-aligned
Max iterations: 4
Between iterations run: project lint and tests (discover from repo)
Exit when: no slop findings and checks pass
Orientation: read the linked ticket for scope before reviewing the diff.
Step 1: Review diff for debug code, dead branches, naming issues.

loop_contract.name: De-Sloppify Pass
loop_contract.goal: recent changes are clean, minimal, and convention-aligned
loop_contract.exit_when: review finds no slop and project checks pass
guardrails: Do not modify the check command or exit criteria to force success
Do not skip, disable, or bypass checks to pass the exit condition
If stuck after several iterations, stop and report blockers instead of gaming metrics
loop_contract.pacing_notes: Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.
loop_contract.step_1: Review git diff against the base branch with requesting-code-review. Flag debug code, dead branches, naming drift, and convention violations. Prioritize P0/P1 only.

steps.name: Review diff for slop
steps.instruction: Review git diff against the base branch with requesting-code-review. Flag debug code, dead branches, naming drift, and convention violations. Prioritize P0/P1 only.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Review notes list concrete findings with file/line references.

steps.name: Fix with minimal diffs
steps.instruction: Fix findings with the smallest correct diff. No drive-by refactors.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Step 'Fix with minimal diffs' completed with evidence.

steps.name: Run project quality checks
steps.instruction: Run this repo's lint and tests (discover from project config). Do not assume npm.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
- Detect lint and test commands from the repo (package.json, Makefile, pyproject.toml, etc.)
- Do not assume npm — use whatever this project actually uses
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Step 'Run project quality checks' completed with evidence.

steps.name: Evaluate clean pass
steps.instruction: No slop findings remain and quality checks pass.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Step 'Evaluate clean pass' completed with evidence.
